text:
maria: FYI ran a quick diff on the q4b smoke results and there's a ~6pt drop in golden pass for intent detection after today's deploy. likely regression but need to rule out sampling.
chen: noted. the dedupe reshuffle landed at 06:12 which could've changed holdout composition. i'll pull sampler logs and hashes.
sam: label-ops available. we can do a micro rerun with focused cases. what slice should we prioritize?
maria: olivia flagged short-system prompts and multi-intent synths as most affected. olivia, how many cases to be convincing?
olivia: around 300 targeted examples should surface the issue. exported failures to `gs://redwood-curation/q4b-smoke/171306-fails.csv`. patterns: prefix truncation, entity normalization mismatches, and answer-rank swaps.
chen: checked sampler traces: seed rotation toggled bucket assignment for ~12% of cohort. sampler invocation in prod:```bash
python sample_bank.py --cohort=golden --limit=3000 --rotate-seed=on --seed-bridge
```
if we regenerate with `--rotate-seed=off` we'll get the pre-reshuffle distribution.
sam: i'll spin up a microtask. @label-bot can you create `q4b-micro-300` with high priority and attach a rubric?
label-bot: microtask created: id=20260317-10, name=`q4b-micro-300`, priority=high, ETA=24h. react with :rocket: to expedite.
maria: thanks. olivia, can you run head-to-head evals between rotated and non-rotated samples? include latency traces.
olivia: on it. need the pre-rotation sample hash. chen?
chen: saved earlier: `sha256:b7f3a9c2d1e8f0a2c3b4e5f67890abcd1234567890abcdef1234567890abcdef`. regen command:```bash
python sample_bank.py --cohort=golden --limit=300 --rotate-seed=off --seed=42 --out=regen-171306.csv
```
I'll drop artifacts to `gs://redwood-curation/q4b-smoke/regen-171306/`.
sam: i'll post a terse rubric for the raters: 1) intent-presence: is the primary intent present? 2) entity-normalization: does the answer canonicalize the entity? 3) ranking: if multiple valid answers, choose the canonical human-labeled response. doc: https://docs.redwood.ai/curation/q4b-micro-rubric (internal).
olivia: running bench now. config snippet from smoke run:```json
{"model":"q4b-v2","compile_flags":["int4-fast-matmul","kvcache-swap"],"batch_size":1,"max_ctx":2048}
```
noticed a kernel fallback at 06:07 in infra logs, might affect tokenization path. adding `--trace=lite` to eval.
maria: good catch. i'll file INF-3282 and attach logs. if both samples fail similarly -> kernel/quant problem. if only rotated fails -> sampling/dedupe.
chen: regen started, will post new sha when done.
sam: label-bot updated microtask to include regen file mapping. contractors available tonight to accelerate.
label-bot: update -> expedited by reaction. assigned to contractor-team-2.
olivia: quick TL;DR when done: posting summary + CSVs to the bucket. plan a 30m sync tomorrow 09:30 PT to decide escalation.
maria: thanks team. sam please own the label handoff and qc. chen please own sampler artifact. olivia own evals. i'll coordinate with quant kernel if needed.
chen: regen finished. uploaded `regen-171306.csv`, hash=`sha256:b7f3a9c2d1e8f0a2c3b4e5f67890abcd1234567890abcdef1234567890abcdef`. bucket: `gs://redwood-curation/q4b-smoke/regen-171306/`.
olivia: head-to-head done. preliminary: rotated sample shows the 6pt drop; regen (non-rotated) matches baseline. attaching full CSVs. seems sampling change is the culprit.
maria: perfect — that narrows it. next steps: revert dedupe seed rotation for golden cohort, add a guard to the dedupe job to avoid rotating golden seeds, and run a wider canary. i'll open a change request.
sam: will run a backward-compat holdout verification and close microtask after QC.
olivia: adding note to release playbook: log compile flags & kernel fallback markers in daily smoke.
label-bot: microtask `q4b-micro-300` -> completed.
maria: great work. closing here; we'll follow up in INF-3282 with remediation plan. thanks everyone for the quick turnaround.
